messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Venlafaxine is used in adults to treat major depressive disorder.
Venlafaxine extended-release capsules are used to treat generalized anxiety disorder.
Generalized anxiety disorder is excessive worrying that is difficult to control.
Venlafaxine extended-release capsules are also used to treat social anxiety disorder.
Social anxiety disorder is extreme fear of interacting with others or performing in front of others that interferes with normal life.
Venlafaxine extended-release capsules are also used to treat panic disorder.
Panic disorder is sudden, unexpected attacks of extreme fear and worry about these attacks.
Venlafaxine belongs to a class of medications called selective serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs).
Venlafaxine works by increasing the amounts of serotonin and norepinephrine.
Serotonin and norepinephrine are natural substances in the brain.
These substances help maintain mental balance.
Triples: [["Venlafaxine", "treats", "major depressive disorder"], ["Venlafaxine extended-release capsules", "treats", "generalized anxiety disorder"], ["generalized anxiety disorder", "defined as", "excessive worrying that is difficult to control"], ["Venlafaxine extended-release capsules", "treats", "social anxiety disorder"], ["social anxiety disorder", "defined as", "extreme fear of interacting with others or performing in front of others that interferes with normal life"], ["Venlafaxine extended-release capsules", "treats", "panic disorder"], ["panic disorder", "defined as", "sudden, unexpected attacks of extreme fear and worry about these attacks"], ["Venlafaxine", "belongs to drug class", "selective serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs)"], ["Venlafaxine", "has mechanism of action", "increasing the amounts of serotonin and norepinephrine"], ["serotonin and norepinephrine", "are", "natural substances in the brain"], ["serotonin and norepinephrine", "help maintain", "mental balance"]]
Relations: ["are", "belongs to drug class", "defined as", "has mechanism of action", "help maintain", "treats"]
Answer:

completion:
are: The subject entities are the same as or are examples of the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
defined as: The subject condition or entity is characterized by the description provided in the object entity.
has mechanism of action: The subject drug functions by the mechanism described in the object entity.
help maintain: The subject substances contribute to the maintenance of the condition or function described in the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
